newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks rally as buying enthusiasm returns.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks rally as buying enthusiasm returns.

text.p: South African shares ramped up in busy Thursday dealings on perceptions the heavy selling, which has wiped almost three percent off the market's value this month, was overdone.

Dealers said buyers were lured into the market during the morning when it became evident futures players, who have been responsible for large-volume arbitrage sales, were keeping largely to the sidelines.
Gold stocks jumped for the first time in many sessions, initially boosted by bullion's climb above the $383 level on Wednesday night.
The overall index ended 60.6 points firmer at 6,815.9 supported by the industrial index which rose 66.1 points to 7,980.2 and the gold index up 31.7 points at 1,743.6.
